980|# Tau Launcher — modular, multi-user, multi-LLM
981|#
982|# Collapse chain (first hit wins):
983|#   1. $TAU_BIN (explicit override)
984|#   2. Installed `tau` on PATH (not this script — avoids recursion)
985|#   3. ./tau in current directory (local project override; regular file only)
986|#   4. Full compiled binary: <engine>/packages/coding-agent/dist/tau
987|#      (hermetic. 2026-09-20 tau-config: promoted above bun source mode.)
988|#   5. Source mode: bun run <engine>/packages/coding-agent/src/cli.ts
989|#      (dev fallback -- patches take effect immediately)
990|#
991|# Launcher-native subcommands (handled before the collapse chain):
992|#   tau vendor ...   upstream patch workflow
993|#   tau audit        read-only hyper-fix audit of config, skills, engine, bridge
994|#   tau tmux ...     tmux session management for parallel experiments
995|# Helpers live next to this script (tau-audit.sh, tau-tmux.sh).
996|#
997|# Profiles: $HOME/.tau/profiles/<name>.yml
998|#   Each profile selects LLM backend, model, and engine args.
999|#   Use --profile <name> or TAU_PROFILE env.
1000|#
1001|# Locking: flock on $HOME/.tau/.launcher.lock prevents concurrent
1002|#   state-corrupting runs. Held only during startup/migration, not
1003|#   for the whole session.
1004|#
1005|# Migrations: profile schema versioned. On load, if profile version
1006|#   < CURRENT_SCHEMA, migrate forward automatically.
1007|
1008|set -euo pipefail
1009|
1010|SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
1011|
1012|# ── HOME resolution (multi-user) ──────────────────────────────────────
1013|# Never hardcode /home/toxic. Respect $HOME; the bridge sometimes runs
1014|# with HOME=/home/hatch even as user toxic, so fall back to the real
1015|# user's home via getent when $HOME looks wrong.
1016|resolve_home() {
1017|    local h="${HOME:-}"
1018|    if [ -n "$h" ] && [ -d "$h/.tau" ]; then
1019|        printf '%s' "$h"
1020|        return
1021|    fi
1022|    local user_home
1023|    user_home="$(getent passwd "${USER:-$(id -un)}" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f6)"
1024|    if [ -n "$user_home" ] && [ -d "$user_home" ]; then
1025|        printf '%s' "$user_home"
1026|        return
1027|    fi
1028|    printf '%s' "${h:-/home/toxic}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tau Launcher — modular, multi-user, multi-LLM
#
# Collapse chain (first hit wins):
#   1. $TAU_BIN (explicit override)
#   2. Installed `tau` on PATH (not this script — avoids recursion)
#   3. ./tau in current directory (local project override; regular file only)
#   4. Full compiled binary: <engine>/packages/coding-agent/dist/tau
#      (hermetic. 2026-09-20 tau-config: promoted above bun source mode.)
#   5. Source mode: bun run <engine>/packages/coding-agent/src/cli.ts
#      (dev fallback -- patches take effect immediately)
#
# Launcher-native subcommands (handled before the collapse chain):
#   tau vendor ...   upstream patch workflow
#   tau audit        read-only hyper-fix audit of config, skills, engine, bridge
#   tau tmux ...     tmux session management for parallel experiments
# Helpers live next to this script (tau-audit.sh, tau-tmux.sh).
#
# Profiles: $HOME/.tau/profiles/<name>.yml
#   Each profile selects LLM backend, model, and engine args.
#   Use --profile <name> or TAU_PROFILE env.
#
# Locking: flock on $HOME/.tau/.launcher.lock prevents concurrent
#   state-corrupting runs. Held only during startup/migration, not
#   for the whole session.
#
# Migrations: profile schema versioned. On load, if profile version
#   < CURRENT_SCHEMA, migrate forward automatically.

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"

# ── HOME resolution (multi-user) ──────────────────────────────────────
# Never hardcode /home/toxic. Respect $HOME; the bridge sometimes runs
# with HOME=/home/hatch even as user toxic, so fall back to the real
# user's home via getent when $HOME looks wrong.
resolve_home() {
    local h="${HOME:-}"
    if [ -n "$h" ] && [ -d "$h/.tau" ]; then
        printf '%s' "$h"
        return
    fi
    local user_home
    user_home="$(getent passwd "${USER:-$(id -un)}" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f6)"
    if [ -n "$user_home" ] && [ -d "$user_home" ]; then
        printf '%s' "$user_home"
        return
    fi
    printf '%s' "${h:-/home/toxic}"
}
TAU_HOME="$(resolve_home)"
export TAU_HOME

TAU_DIR="$TAU_HOME/.tau"
PROFILES_DIR="$TAU_DIR/profiles"
LOCK_FILE="$TAU_DIR/.launcher.lock"
CURRENT_SCHEMA=2

mkdir -p "$PROFILES_DIR"
